summary: The change adds the raw payee `account_number`—an explicitly registered NPI field—into an f-string that is passed to `self._log.error()`. Because the f-string is fully evaluated before the string reaches the logger, any parameter-level masking in AppLog cannot intercept it, and the unmasked NPI will appear in the log on every statement-delivery failure. This is a direct violation of LOG-1 ('No application log entry contains an unmasked NPI value, on any path including error paths'). The change-management process obligations (CHG-1 through CHG-4) are satisfied, but the NPI-in-log violation is sufficient to reject the change.
